snapshot_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive
  local found=0

  mkdir -p "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}"
  : > "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"

  for rel in ${LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS}; do
    if test ! -d "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/${rel}"; then
      echo "Local source snapshot: skip missing ${rel}" >&2
      continue
    fi

    archive="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/${rel//\//__}.tar"
    # Snapshot user-owned source/config only.  Never preserve generated
    # objects/archives, otherwise restore_local_sources() can resurrect stale
    # code after a context/clean operation.
    tar -C "${OPENVELA_ROOT}" \
      --exclude=.git \
      --exclude='*.o' \
      --exclude='*.a' \
      --exclude='*.d' \
      --exclude='*.gcno' \
      --exclude='*.gcda' \
      -cpf "${archive}" "${rel}"
    printf '%s\n' "${rel}" >> "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"
    found=1
  done

  if test "${found}" != 1; then
    echo "No local source roots were found; refusing to build without source protection." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "Local source snapshot created; context may not replace local source files."
}

restore_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive

  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    archive="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/${rel//\//__}.tar"
    tar -C "${OPENVELA_ROOT}" -xpf "${archive}"
  done < "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"

  echo "Local source snapshot restored; compiling the files present before context."
}

run_configured_make()
{
  local extra_flags="-Wno-cpp -Wno-deprecated-declarations"
  local voice_hooks=0
  local cc_command
  local voice_launcher="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/scripts/voice_gcc.sh"
  local -a make_args=()
  if ! is_maintenance_target "$@" && grep -Eq '^CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_295_ROBOT_VOICE=y$' "${NUTTX_DIR}/.config" 2>/dev/null; then
    if test ! -f "${VOICE_HOOK_HEADER}"; then
      echo "Missing contest HTTP hook header: ${VOICE_HOOK_HEADER}" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    extra_flags+=" -DROBOT_VOICE_AGENT_INTERPOSE=1"
    voice_hooks=1
  fi

  # Match build.sh's configuration environment without invoking context a
  # second time after the ai_agent patch has been applied.
  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  set +e
  set +u
  source "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/build/envsetup.sh"
  set -e
  set -u
  export PATH="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/prebuilts/kconfig-frontends/bin:${PATH}"

  # Important: build only.  Do NOT run savedefconfig here and do NOT copy the
  # generated defconfig back into the board source tree.  A diagnostic build
  # must not silently mutate the persistent NSH board configuration.
  if test "${voice_hooks}" = 1; then
    # CC must contain one executable, with no wrapper-specific -- separators:
    # mkdeps parses CC -- CFLAGS -- files before invoking the compiler.
    cc_command="$(make --no-print-directory -s -C "${NUTTX_DIR}" \
      --eval='__rv_print_cc:;@printf "%s\n" "$(CC)"' __rv_print_cc)"
    if test -z "${cc_command}"; then
      echo "Unable to resolve configured C compiler" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    if ! test -x "${voice_launcher}" || ! test -f "${voice_launcher%/*}/voice_cc.py"; then
      echo "Missing executable voice compiler launcher: ${voice_launcher}" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    export ROBOT_VOICE_REAL_CC="${cc_command}"
    export ROBOT_VOICE_HOOK_HEADER="${VOICE_HOOK_HEADER}"
    make_args+=("CC=${voice_launcher}")
  fi
  make -C "${NUTTX_DIR}" EXTRAFLAGS="${extra_flags}" "${make_args[@]}" "$@"
}

verify_voice_fix_sources()
{
  if test "${VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED}" != 1; then
    echo "Voice source policy verification: SKIPPED; local packages/ai_agent source is authoritative (VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED=${VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED})"
    return 0
  fi

  test -f "${VOICE_TLS_SRC}" || {
    echo "Missing voice TLS source: ${VOICE_TLS_SRC}" >&2
    exit 1
  }

  test -f "${VOICE_MIMO_SRC}" || {
    echo "Missing MiMo voice source: ${VOICE_MIMO_SRC}" >&2
    exit 1
  }

  local missing=0

  for marker in \
    'DNS start:' \
    'TCP connect start:' \
    'upload progress:'; do
    if ! grep -Fq "${marker}" "${VOICE_TLS_SRC}"; then
      echo "Voice fix marker missing from vela_tls.c: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi
  done

  # The build wrapper must verify capability, not dictate runtime key policy.
  # Accept either lookup order as long as both the generic fallback and the
  # MiMo-specific key path still exist in get_api_key().
  local key_block
  key_block="$(
    sed -n '/static int get_api_key/,/^}/p' "${VOICE_MIMO_SRC}"
  )"

  if ! grep -Fq 'AGENT_CFG_KEY_MIMO_API_KEY' <<<"${key_block}"; then
    echo "MiMo voice key support is missing in mimo_voice.c" >&2
    missing=1
  fi

  if ! grep -Fq 'AGENT_CFG_KEY_API_KEY' <<<"${key_block}"; then
    echo "Generic API key fallback is missing in mimo_voice.c" >&2
    missing=1
  fi

  local first_key
  first_key="$(
    grep -Eo 'AGENT_CFG_KEY_(MIMO_API_KEY|API_KEY)' <<<"${key_block}" |
      head -n 1 || true
  )"

  if test "${first_key}" != "AGENT_CFG_KEY_MIMO_API_KEY"; then
    echo "Voice fix source verification: NOTE - get_api_key() checks ${first_key:-no-key} first; build allowed."
  fi

  # The current MiMo TTS path must use incremental HTTP/Base64/WAV
  # processing and feed PCM through the voice streaming callback.  Do not
  # require the old whole-response TTS markers here: those belong to the
  # retired fixed-buffer implementation.
  for marker in \
    'TTS streaming request' \
    'mimo_tts_stream_synthesize' \
    '.stream_synthesize = mimo_tts_stream_synthesize'; do
    if ! grep -Fq "${marker}" "${VOICE_MIMO_SRC}"; then
      echo "Streaming TTS marker missing from mimo_voice.c: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi
  done

  # Streaming TTS depends on the incremental HTTPS response path in vela_tls.
  for marker in \
    'vela_https_post_json_stream' \
    'transport stream enter:'; do
    if ! grep -Fq "${marker}" "${VOICE_TLS_SRC}"; then
      echo "Streaming HTTPS marker missing from vela_tls.c: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi
  done

  if test "${missing}" != 0; then
    echo "Refusing to build: expected voice-chain fixes are not present." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "Voice fix source verification: OK"
}

      "${NUTTX_DIR}/.config" && \
      ! grep -aF 'robot_agentctl_main' "${elf}" >/dev/null; then
    echo "Post-build verification failed: ELF missing robot_agentctl marker" >&2

  # historical ai_agent streaming implementation.  When the legacy
  # voice_echo app is disabled, validate the new app marker and do not require
  # private symbols/strings from packages/ai_agent.

    return 0
  fi

  # The official ai_agent source does not promise the contest-local streaming
  # MiMo markers.  Only enforce them when the caller explicitly requests the
  # voice-fix source contract.

    echo "Post-build streaming voice verification: SKIPPED (VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED=${VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED})"
    return 0
  fi

  local missing=0

  # Verify that the streaming TTS implementation and streaming HTTPS
  # transport actually reached the final firmware image.
  for marker in \
    'TTS streaming request' \
    'transport stream enter:'; do
    if ! strings "${elf}" | grep -Fq "${marker}"; then
      echo "Post-build verification failed: ELF missing streaming marker: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi
  done

  # The old fixed-buffer diagnostics should not survive in the final image.
  # Their presence usually means an old mimo_voice object/archive was linked.
  for marker in \
    'TTS response bytes=' \
    'TTS audio base64 bytes=' \
    'TTS WAV bytes=' \
    'TTS PCM output too small'; do
    if strings "${elf}" | grep -Fq "${marker}"; then

  fi

CSRCS += src/node/node_client.c

ifeq ($(CONFIG_AI_AGENT_TEST),y)
CSRCS += tests/integs/test_vision_integ.c
endif

MAINSRC = src/agent_main.c

# Force agent_main.c to recompile every build so that
# AGENT_BUILD_VERSION stays fresh.  The $(shell date ...)
# value changes every invocation, invalidating the cached .o.
CFLAGS += -DAGENT_BUILD_TIMESTAMP='"$(shell date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")"'

PRIORITY  = $(CONFIG_EXAMPLES_AI_AGENT_VELA_PRIORITY)

`contest2026_295_suanliheidong/packages/ai_agent/src` 是 AI Agent 的 C 源码实现目录，主要负责语音链路和 HTTPS 传输。

需要注意：这里是“差异 overlay”，不是完整的 `ai_agent` 源码。未修改的 `core/`、`llm/`、`tools/` 等目录仍来自顶层官方 `packages/ai_agent`。

主要文件：

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `voice/voice_channel.c` | 语音总控制器：录音、ASR、把识别文本推入 `message_bus`、接收回复并触发 TTS 播放 |
| `voice/audio_capture.c` | 采集 PCM 音频，支持 ALSA、开发板 I2S0、Media Recorder 回退 |
| `voice/audio_playback.c` | 播放 PCM 音频，支持开发板 I2S1 或 `media_player` |
| `voice/voice_asr.c` | ASR 后端注册、切换和调用，处理批量/流式识别 |
| `voice/voice_tts.c` | TTS 后端注册、切换和调用，支持流式播放 |
| `voice/mimo_voice.c` | MiMo ASR/TTS 实现，包括请求构造、鉴权、Base64/WAV 解码、流式 TTS |
| `voice/volc_asr.c` | 火山引擎 ASR 后端，包含流式识别逻辑 |
| `voice/volc_tts.c` | 火山引擎 TTS 后端 |
| `infra/vela_tls.c` | mbedTLS HTTPS 传输，包括连接复用、普通 POST 和流式响应 |
| `infra/vela_tls.h` | HTTPS/TLS 接口声明 |
| `voice/*_h` | 上述模块的接口和数据结构声明 |

核心调用链大致是：

```text
voice_channel_start()
    -> audio_capture_read()
    -> voice_asr_stream_send()/finish()
    -> message_bus_push_inbound()
    -> Agent/LLM
    -> voice_channel_speak()
    -> voice_tts_speak_stream()
    -> audio_playback_write()
```

其中，`voice_channel.c` 会优先注册 MiMo 后端，再注册火山引擎后端；相关代码见 [voice_channel.c:608](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/packages/ai_agent/src/voice/voice_channel.c:608)。

另外，`src/voice/audio_playback_可以用整体换存完播放.c` 当前没有出现在 `CMakeLists.txt` 或 `Makefile` 的源文件列表中，因此不会参与正常编译，属于额外保留的实验/备份文件。

# openvela Build

编译 openvela 固件、修改内核配置、运行模拟器。

## 默认目标

默认编译目标为 goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap（64 位 ARM 模拟器）：

```
CONFIG_PATH=vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
OUTPUT_DIR=cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

如果用户指定了其他板级配置路径，替换上述路径即可。

## 命令

### 编译

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

示例：
```bash
./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

**成功标志**: 输出 `#### build completed successfully`

**编译产物**: `<OUTPUT_DIR>/nuttx`（ELF）、`<OUTPUT_DIR>/vela_ap.bin`

### 修改内核配置（menuconfig）

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake menuconfig
```

menuconfig 是交互式 TUI 界面，**不能在 AI 终端中直接运行**。提示用户在自己的终端中执行。

修改配置后保存会自动更新 `.config`。如需持久化到 defconfig：
```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake savedefconfig
```

### 运行模拟器

```bash
./emulator.sh <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

示例：
```bash
./emulator.sh cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

**成功标志**: 出现 `goldfish-armv8a-ap>` NSH 提示符

### 清理编译

```bash
rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

全量清理后重新编译：
```bash
rm -rf cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ && ./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

## 编译流程

1. 用户指定或确认目标配置路径
2. 执行 `./build.sh <path> --cmake -j$(nproc)`
3. 检查输出最后几行是否包含 `build completed successfully`
4. 如果编译失败，分析错误日志并尝试修复（最多 3 轮）

## 编译失败处理

| 错误类型 | 特征 | 处理 |
|----------|------|------|
| 代码错误 | `error:` + 本驱动文件名 | 自动修复代码，重新编译 |
| 配置缺失 | `undefined reference` + CONFIG 相关 | 提示用户 menuconfig 开启 |
| 工具链问题 | `command not found` | 提示用户安装工具链 |
| 缓存问题 | 奇怪的链接错误 | `rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>` 后重编 |

## 启用新驱动的 CONFIG

如果需要临时启用某个 CONFIG 进行编译验证：

```bash
# 方法 1: 直接追加到 defconfig（推荐）
echo "CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y" >> <CONFIG_PATH>/defconfig

# 方法 2: 用 sed 修改 .config（临时，不持久化）
sed -i 's/# CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680 is not set/CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y/' <OUTPUT_DIR>/.config
```

修改后重新编译即可。

## 常用配置路径

| 目标 | 配置路径 |
|------|----------|
| goldfish-arm64 (推荐) | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/` |
| goldfish-arm32 | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-armeabi-v7a-ap/` |
| 自定义板级 | `vendor/<vendor>/boards/<chip>/<board>/configs/<config>/` |

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Build the contest ESP32-S3 board with a temporary, reversible
# esp-hal-3rdparty lock-initializer backport.
#
# Fresh workspaces may not contain esp-hal-3rdparty yet. NuttX prepares it
# during the normal build context phase, so this wrapper bootstraps that
# phase first when needed, then applies the local backport and performs the
# real build.
# ROBOT_VOICE_TRANSPORT_HOOKS_V2: contest-local Agent source tree is authoritative.

set -euo pipefail

readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly OPENVELA_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../../.." && pwd)"
readonly CONFIG_PATH="vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_295_board/configs/nsh"
readonly HAL_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/esp_hal_lock_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_BREAK_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/nuttx_xtensa_break_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_RAW_EXC_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/nuttx_xtensa_raw_exception_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_RAW_EXC="${NUTTX_RAW_EXC:-0}"
readonly AI_AGENT_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/ai_agent_esp32s3_backport.sh"  # compatibility-only; never edits Agent source
readonly FFMPEG_AMIX_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/ffmpeg_amix_backport.sh"
readonly VOICE_HOOK_HEADER="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/robot_voice_agent_hooks.h"
readonly MYENV_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/myenv"
readonly BUILD_SH="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/build.sh"
readonly NUTTX_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/nuttx"
readonly HAL_DIR="${NUTTX_DIR}/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3/esp-hal-3rdparty"
readonly AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/packages/ai_agent"

readonly VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED="${VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED:-0}"
readonly VOICE_TLS_SRC="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/src/infra/vela_tls.c"
readonly VOICE_MIMO_SRC="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/src/voice/mimo_voice.c"
# These are user-owned source trees.  build.sh context is allowed to prepare
# its generated context and HAL checkout, but it must not replace local source
# files before the actual make.  Override this list when the project layout
# uses different source roots.
readonly LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS="${LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS:-packages/ai_agent contest2026_295_suanliheidong/packages/ai_agent contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src}"
readonly LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/openvela-local-source-${BASHPID}"

cd "${OPENVELA_ROOT}"

snapshot_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive
  local found=0

  mkdir -p "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}"
  : > "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"

  for rel in ${LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS}; do
    if test ! -d "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/${rel}"; then
      echo "Local source snapshot: skip missing ${rel}" >&2
      continue
    fi

    archive="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/${rel//\//__}.tar"
    # Snapshot user-owned source/config only.  Never preserve generated
    # objects/archives, otherwise restore_local_sources() can resurrect stale
    # code after a context/clean operation.
    tar -C "${OPENVELA_ROOT}" \
      --exclude=.git \
      --exclude='*.o' \
      --exclude='*.a' \
      --exclude='*.d' \
      --exclude='*.gcno' \
      --exclude='*.gcda' \
      -cpf "${archive}" "${rel}"
    printf '%s\n' "${rel}" >> "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"
    found=1
  done

  if test "${found}" != 1; then
    echo "No local source roots were found; refusing to build without source protection." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "Local source snapshot created; context may not replace local source files."
}

restore_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive
  local restore_root="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/restore"

  rm -rf "${restore_root}"
  mkdir -p "${restore_root}"

# intentionally outside the compatibility-patch lifecycle: temporary HAL and
# NuttX backports may be applied/reversed, but local source must be compiled
# exactly as it existed when this script started.
# Repair the contest copy, never the temporary upstream copy. The same
# preparation runs for direct shell builds and build_voice.py builds.
python3 "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/scripts/build_voice.py" \
  --openvela "${OPENVELA_ROOT}" --prepare-only

snapshot_local_sources
trap restore_backports EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM

# Context needs a complete Agent even when packages/ai_agent was deleted.
apply_contest_ai_agent_overlay
refresh_demo_kconfig
bootstrap_hal_checkout
prepare_build_context
restore_local_sources
apply_contest_ai_agent_overlay
python3 "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/scripts/fix_link_dependencies.py" \
  --openvela "${OPENVELA_ROOT}" --verify-active

# Compile contest-owned strong public voice/HTTP entry points and weak upstream
# defaults via EXTRAFLAGS. The complete contest Agent is staged temporarily.
# Application Make/CMake no longer infer a nonexistent streaming callback ABI.

# The first build.sh context is required to create the normal ESP32-S3 build
# environment, but it may have generated the robot_voice source list before
# the user's contest-local files were restored.  Refresh context now so new
# files such as robot_music_player.c are part of apps_robot_voice/libapps.a.
refresh_restored_build_context

patch_state="$("${HAL_PATCH_TOOL}" apply)"
echo "HAL backport: ${patch_state}"

if test "${patch_state}" = "APPLIED"; then
  hal_rollback=1
fi

patch_state="$("${NUTTX_BREAK_PATCH_TOOL}" apply)"
echo "NuttX Xtensa BREAK backport: ${patch_state}"

if test "${patch_state}" = "APPLIED"; then
  nuttx_break_rollback=1
fi

if test "${NUTTX_RAW_EXC}" = 1; then
  patch_state="$(${NUTTX_RAW_EXC_PATCH_TOOL} apply)"
  echo "NuttX raw Xtensa exception diagnostic: ${patch_state}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sync board network buffers and C++17, then run the existing board build."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
from fix_tflite_cxx_standard import configure_cxx17
from fix_link_dependencies import configure_link_dependencies, verify_active

VOICE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

BOARD_KCONFIG = {
    'CONFIG_IOB_BUFSIZE': '512',
    'CONFIG_IOB_NBUFFERS': '128',
    'CONFIG_IOB_THROTTLE': '16',
    'CONFIG_NET_RECV_BUFSIZE': '8192',
    'CONFIG_NET_TCP_DELAYED_ACK': 'n',
}

def config_values(path):
    values = {}
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith('CONFIG_') and '=' in line:
            name, value = line.split('=', 1)
            values[name] = value.strip('"')
        elif line.startswith('# CONFIG_') and line.endswith(' is not set'):
            values[line[2:-11]] = 'n'
    return values

def set_config_value(text, name, value):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    prefix = name + '='
    disabled = '# ' + name + ' is not set'
    replacement = disabled if value == 'n' else prefix + value
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.startswith(prefix) or line == disabled:
            lines[i] = replacement
            break
    else:
        lines.append(replacement)
    return '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'

def sync_board_network_config(root):
    source = root / 'contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/configs/nsh/defconfig'
    target = root / 'vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_295_board/configs/nsh/defconfig'
    if not source.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError('contest board defconfig missing: ' + str(source))
    if not target.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError('active vendor board defconfig missing: ' + str(target))

    expected = config_values(source)
    for name, value in BOARD_KCONFIG.items():
        if expected.get(name) != value:
            raise RuntimeError('contest defconfig has unexpected ' + name + '=' +
                               str(expected.get(name)) + '; expected ' + value)

    original = target.read_text()
    updated = original
    for name, value in BOARD_KCONFIG.items():
        updated = set_config_value(updated, name, value)
    if updated != original:
        backup = target.with_name(target.name + '.before-robot-voice-network')
        if not backup.exists():
            backup.write_text(original)
        target.write_text(updated)
        print('[voice-build] synced board IOB/TCP receive settings into ' + str(target))

def verify_active_board_config(root):
    active = root / 'nuttx/.config'
    if not active.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError('board build returned success but nuttx/.config is missing')
    values = config_values(active)
    errors = [name + '=' + str(values.get(name)) + ' expected ' + value
              for name, value in BOARD_KCONFIG.items()
              if values.get(name) != value]
    if errors:
        raise RuntimeError('active NuttX configuration did not apply board audio/network settings: ' +
                           ', '.join(errors))
    print('[voice-build] active NuttX IOB/TCP receive settings verified')

def restore_legacy_backup(root):
    state = VOICE / 'scripts/.agent-adapter-state'
    manifest = json.loads((state / 'state.json').read_text())
    target = Path(manifest['target']).resolve()
    if not target.is_relative_to((root / 'packages/ai_agent').resolve()):
        raise RuntimeError('legacy backup target is outside this official Agent tree')
    if hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != manifest['patched_sha256']:
        raise RuntimeError('official file changed; refusing to overwrite it. Backup: ' + str(state))
    target.write_bytes((state / 'original.c').read_bytes())
    (state / 'state.json').unlink()
    (state / 'original.c').unlink()
    state.rmdir()
    print('[voice-build] restored interrupted legacy policy patch')

def main():

def enable_config(data, key):
    """Enable one Kconfig boolean while preserving other config lines."""
    newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in data else '\n'
    pattern = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:' + re.escape(key) + r'=.*|#\s*' +
                         re.escape(key) + r' is not set)\s*$')
    lines = []
    inserted = False
    for line in data.splitlines(keepends=True):
        if pattern.fullmatch(line.rstrip('\r\n')):
            if not inserted:
                lines.append(key + '=y' + newline)
                inserted = True
        else:
            lines.append(line)
    if not inserted:
        if lines and not lines[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
            lines.append(newline)
        lines.append(key + '=y' + newline)
    return ''.join(lines)

    if 'src/tools/mcp_server.c' in missing:
        lines.extend(('ifeq ($(CONFIG_AI_AGENT_MCP),y)',
                      'CSRCS += src/tools/mcp_server.c', 'endif'))
    lines.append(MAKE_END)

    include = r'(?m)^include\s+\$[({]APPDIR[)}]/Application\.mk\s*$'
    matches = list(re.finditer(include, text))
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError('cannot locate unique Application.mk include in packages/ai_agent/Makefile')
    newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in text else '\n'
    addition = newline.join(lines) + newline
    start = matches[0].start()
    return text[:start] + addition + text[start:]


def ensure_agent_link_anchor(text):
    """Keep the voice provider and its FFmpeg compatibility object reachable."""
    declaration = 'extern void robot_voice_link_anchor(void);'
    call = 'robot_voice_link_anchor();'
    if call not in text:
        include = '#include "voice/voice_channel.h"'
        if text.count(include) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError('cannot locate unique voice_channel.h include in agent_main.c')
        pattern = r'(?m)^([ \t]*)rc\s*=\s*voice_channel_init\s*\(\s*\)\s*;\s*$'
        matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, text))
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError('cannot locate unique rc = voice_channel_init(); in agent_main.c')
        newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in text else '\n'
        m = matches[0]
        block = (m.group(1) + '#ifdef CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_295_ROBOT_VOICE' + newline +
                 m.group(1) + '  ' + call + newline +
                 m.group(1) + '#endif' + newline)
        text = text[:m.start()] + block + text[m.start():]
    if declaration not in text:
        include = '#include "voice/voice_channel.h"'
        if text.count(include) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError('cannot locate unique voice_channel.h include in agent_main.c')
        newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in text else '\n'
        declaration_block = ('#ifdef CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_295_ROBOT_VOICE' + newline +
                             declaration + newline + '#endif' + newline)
        text = text.replace(include, include + newline + declaration_block, 1)
    return text


def ensure_amix_link_anchor(text):
    """Add a passive archive anchor only after checking the real amix code."""
    if '#include "../../../external/ffmpeg/ffmpeg/libavfilter/amix.c"' in text:
        if 'void robot_ffmpeg_amix_compat_link_anchor(void)' not in text:
            raise RuntimeError('real FFmpeg include requires its archive anchor')
        return text
    for name in AMIX:
        if not re.search(r'\bff_amix_' + name + r'\s*\([^;{}]*\)\s*\{', text, re.S):
            raise RuntimeError('robot_core compatibility source is missing real ff_amix_' + name)
    if re.search(r'\brobot_ffmpeg_amix_compat_link_anchor\s*\(\s*(?:void)?\s*\)\s*\{', text):
        return text
    newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in text else '\n'
    suffix = '' if not text or text.endswith(('\n', '\r')) else newline
    return (text + suffix + newline +
            '/* RV295_LINK_V1: retain this object from static archives. */' + newline +
            'void robot_ffmpeg_amix_compat_link_anchor(void) {}' + newline)


def write_backup(path, text):
    before = path.read_bytes()
    after = text.encode('utf-8')
    if before == after:
        return False
    shutil.copy2(path, backup_name(path))
    path.write_bytes(after)
    return True


def backup_name(path):
    base = path.with_name(path.name + '.before-voice-link-fix')
    candidate = base
    suffix = 0
    while candidate.exists() or candidate.is_symlink():
        suffix += 1
        candidate = Path(str(base) + '.' + str(suffix))
    return candidate


def validate_inputs(root, check_patches=True):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    voice = root / CONTEST / 'app/robot_voice'
    agent = root / CONTEST / 'packages/ai_agent'
    core = voice.parent / 'robot_core'
    # These are existing project components, not substitute/dummy providers.
    required = (
        voice / 'Makefile', voice / 'Make.defs', voice / 'Kconfig',
        voice / 'robot_voice_main.c', voice / 'scripts/voice_gcc.sh',
        voice / 'scripts/voice_cc.py', voice / 'robot_wakeword_tflm.cc',
        voice / 'robot_wakeword_model_data.cc',
        agent / 'Makefile', agent / 'Kconfig',
        agent / 'src/core/message_bus.c', agent / 'src/core/message_bus_tap.c',
        agent / 'src/channels/cmd_voice.c',
        core / 'robot_ffmpeg_amix_compat.c', core / 'robot_ffmpeg_amix_compat.h',
        agent / 'src/agent_main.c',
        root / CONTEST / 'scripts/generate_skill_bundle.py',
        root / CONTEST / 'board/contest_board/scripts/build_with_hal_backport.sh',
        root / CONTEST / 'board/contest_board/configs/nsh/defconfig',
        root / 'vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_295_board/configs/nsh/defconfig',
    )
    missing = [str(p) for p in required if not p.is_file()]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError('missing real project inputs (do not use stubs):\n' + '\n'.join(missing))
    if 'MODEL_NOT_IMPORTED' in (voice / 'robot_wakeword_model_data.cc').read_text():
        raise RuntimeError('import the real wakeword model before building')
    if not re.search(r'\bvoid\s+robot_voice_link_anchor\s*\(\s*void\s*\)\s*\{',
                     read_text(voice / 'robot_voice_main.c')):
        raise RuntimeError('robot_voice_main.c does not define the strong voice link anchor')
    for source in (agent / 'src/agent_main.c', voice / 'robot_voice_main.c'):
        if check_patches and 'robot_voice_link_anchor' not in source.read_text():
            raise RuntimeError('install both source changes first: ' + str(source))
    make_sources = re.findall(r'\bsrc/[\w/.-]+\.c\b', (agent / 'Makefile').read_text())
    missing_sources = [str(agent / name) for name in make_sources
                       if not (agent / name).is_file()]
    if missing_sources:
        raise RuntimeError('contest Agent is not a complete source tree; sync would delete base files:\n' +
                           '\n'.join(missing_sources))
    compat = read_text(core / 'robot_ffmpeg_amix_compat.c')
    ensure_amix_link_anchor(compat)
    return root, voice, required[-2], required[-1]


def configure_link_dependencies(root, check=False):
    root, voice, source_config, vendor_config = validate_inputs(root, check_patches=False)
    agent = root / CONTEST / 'packages/ai_agent'
    agent_main = agent / 'src/agent_main.c'
    agent_make = agent / 'Makefile'
    compat_source = voice.parent / 'robot_core/robot_ffmpeg_amix_compat.c'
    planned_agent_main = ensure_agent_link_anchor(read_text(agent_main))
    planned_agent_make = ensure_agent_make_sources(read_text(agent_make),
        {str(p.relative_to(agent)) for p in (agent / 'src').rglob('*.c')})
    planned_compat = ensure_amix_link_anchor(read_text(compat_source))
    link = root / 'packages/demos/contest2026_295_robot_voice'
    configs = [source_config.resolve(), vendor_config.resolve()]
    configs = list(dict.fromkeys(configs))
    planned_configs = {}
    for p in configs:
        text = p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
        for key in (*REQUIRED, 'CONFIG_PWM',
                    'CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_295_ROBOTCTL',
                    'CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_295_ROBOT_AGENTCTL'):
            text = enable_config(text, key)
        planned_configs[p] = text
    bad = [str(p) for p in configs if planned_configs[p] != p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')]
    if planned_agent_main != read_text(agent_main):
        bad.append(str(agent_main) + ' needs the voice link anchor')
    if planned_agent_make != read_text(agent_make):
        bad.append(str(agent_make) + ' needs the Agent Make source list repair')
    if planned_compat != read_text(compat_source):
        bad.append(str(compat_source) + ' needs the FFmpeg archive anchor')
    launcher = voice / 'scripts/voice_gcc.sh'
    if check:
        if not os.access(launcher, os.X_OK):
            bad.append(str(launcher) + ' needs executable permission')
        if not link.exists() or link.resolve() != voice.resolve():
            bad.append(str(link) + ' must point to ' + str(voice))
        if bad:
            raise RuntimeError('run without --check to repair:\n' + '\n'.join(bad))
    else:
        launcher.chmod(launcher.stat().st_mode | 0o100)
        if write_backup(agent_main, planned_agent_main):
            print('[voice-link] repaired strong voice anchor in ' + str(agent_main))
        if write_backup(agent_make, planned_agent_make):
            print('[voice-link] repaired Agent Make sources in ' + str(agent_make))
        if write_backup(compat_source, planned_compat):
            print('[voice-link] repaired FFmpeg archive anchor in ' + str(compat_source))
        for path in configs:
            before = path.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
            after = planned_configs[path]
            if before != after:
                shutil.copy2(path, backup_name(path))
                path.write_bytes(after.encode('utf-8'))
                print('[voice-link] enabled contest voice dependencies in ' + str(path))
        if not link.exists() or link.resolve() != voice.resolve():
            link.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if link.exists() or link.is_symlink():
                link.rename(backup_name(link))
            link.symlink_to(voice, target_is_directory=True)
            print('[voice-link] registered ' + str(link))
    print('[voice-link] real voice/model/amix sources and registration checked')


def verify_active(root):
    path = Path(root) / 'nuttx/.config'
    config = values(path)
    bad = [key for key in REQUIRED if config.get(key) != 'y']
    if config.get('CONFIG_CXX_STANDARD') != '"gnu++17"':
        bad.append('CONFIG_CXX_STANDARD="gnu++17"')
    if bad:
        raise RuntimeError('effective nuttx/.config has unsatisfied dependencies: ' + ', '.join(bad))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Set the board's global C++ dialect before its normal configure/build step.

The reported board build fails in libc++ <string> with the default gnu++20
profile. Use C++17 for this application and its libraries. Changing only
robot_voice's CXXFLAGS would leave libc++ itself on the failing profile.
"""
import argparse
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import sys
import tempfile

KEY = 'CONFIG_CXX_STANDARD'
VALUE = '"gnu++17"'
PATTERN = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:#\s*)?CONFIG_CXX_STANDARD(?:\s*=.*|\s+is not set)\s*$')


def set_standard(data):
    """Preserve every other configuration line, including its line ending."""
    text = data.decode('utf-8')
    newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in text else '\n'
    result = []
    inserted = False
    for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True):
        if PATTERN.fullmatch(line.rstrip('\r\n')):
            if not inserted:
                result.append(KEY + '=' + VALUE + newline)
                inserted = True
        else:
            result.append(line)
    if not inserted:
        if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\r', '\n')):
            result.append(newline)
        result.append(KEY + '=' + VALUE + newline)
    return ''.join(result).encode('utf-8')


def atomic_write(path, data):
    name = None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, prefix='cxx17-', delete=False) as f:
            name = Path(f.name)
            f.write(data)
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())
        name.chmod(stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode))
        os.replace(name, path)
    finally:
        if name is not None and name.exists():
            name.unlink()


def configure_cxx17(root, check=False):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    source = root/'contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/configs/nsh/defconfig'
    vendor = root/'vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_295_board/configs/nsh/defconfig'
    if not source.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError('board source defconfig missing: '+str(source))
    paths = []
    for p in [source, *([vendor] if vendor.is_file() else [])]:
        target = p.resolve(strict=True)  # Preserve an existing board symlink.
        if target not in paths:
            paths.append(target)
    changes = []
    for p in paths:
        before = p.read_bytes()
        after = set_standard(before)
        changes.append((p, before, after))
    if check:
        wrong = [str(p) for p, before, after in changes if before != after]
        if wrong:
            raise RuntimeError('set '+KEY+'='+VALUE+' before building: '+', '.join(wrong))
    else:
        for p, before, after in changes:
            if before != after:
                backup = p.with_name(p.name+'.before-tflite-cxx17')
                if not backup.exists():
                    with backup.open('xb') as f:
                        f.write(before)
                atomic_write(p, after)
                print('[voice-build] C++17 profile applied: '+str(p))
    print('[voice-build] '+KEY+'='+VALUE+' (global libc++ and TFLM build)')

# SPLITVARIABLE - Split long variables into specified batches
# Usage: $(call SPLITVARIABLE, variable-def, variable-ref, batch-size)
#
#	Example: VAR:= a b c x y z foo bar
#			 $(call SPLITVARIABLE, VAR, $(VAR), 3)
#			 $(foreach, num, $(VAR_TOTAL), $(shell echo $(VAR_$(num))))
#	Return new variable definition:
#		$(variable-def)_TOTAL : total split sequence , start with 1.
#		$(variable-def)_$(num) : newly defined variable , ended with batch num.
#	In the case above:
#			$(VAR_TOTAL) = 1 2 3
#			$(VAR_1) = a b c
#			$(VAR_2) = x y z
#			$(VAR_3) = foo bar

define SPLITVARIABLE
	$(eval SPLITVARIABLE_PREFIX = $(1))
	$(eval BATCH_SIZE = $(3))
	$(eval TOTAL_BATCH = $(shell expr $(words $(2)) / $(BATCH_SIZE) + 1))
	$(eval $(SPLITVARIABLE_PREFIX)_TOTAL = $(shell seq 1 $(TOTAL_BATCH)))
	$(foreach idx, $($(SPLITVARIABLE_PREFIX)_TOTAL), \
		$(eval FROMINDEX=$(shell expr 1 + $(idx) \* $(BATCH_SIZE) - $(BATCH_SIZE))) \
		$(eval $(SPLITVARIABLE_PREFIX)_$(idx)=$(wordlist $(FROMINDEX), $(shell expr $(FROMINDEX) + $(BATCH_SIZE) - 1), $(2))) \
	)
endef

define ARLOCK
	flock $1.lock $(call ARCHIVE, $1, $(2))
endef

# dynamic AR target

define AROBJSRULES
$(1) : $(2)
	@ cp $(2) $(1)
endef

# CLEANAROBJS - del AR target files exclusively

ifeq ($(CONFIG_WINDOWS_NATIVE),y)
define CLEANAROBJS
	$(call DELFILE,$(subst /,\,$(AROBJS)))
	$(call DELFILE,$(subst /,\,$(OBJS)))
	$(eval OBJS :=)
endef
else
define CLEANAROBJS
	$(call SPLITVARIABLE,CLEAN_AROBJS,${AROBJS},100)
	$(foreach BATCH, $(CLEAN_AROBJS_TOTAL), \
		$(shell rm -rf $(CLEAN_AROBJS_$(BATCH))))
	$(call SPLITVARIABLE,CLEAN_OBJS,${OBJS},100)
	$(foreach BATCH, $(CLEAN_OBJS_TOTAL), \
		$(shell rm -rf $(CLEAN_OBJS_$(BATCH))))
	$(eval OBJS :=)
endef
endif

$(foreach SDIR, $(CONFIGURED_APPS), $(eval $(call SDIR_template,$(SDIR),context)))
$(foreach SDIR, $(CONFIGURED_APPS), $(eval $(call SDIR_template,$(SDIR),register)))
$(foreach SDIR, $(CONFIGURED_APPS), $(eval $(call SDIR_template,$(SDIR),depend)))

else

bootstrap_hal_checkout()
{
  if hal_checkout_ready; then
    return 0
  fi

  echo "HAL checkout is missing:"
  echo "  ${HAL_DIR}"
  echo
  echo "Bootstrapping the normal NuttX build context first..."

  reset_generated_build_state

  # Follow openvela's normal build path so NuttX creates/clones the ESP HAL
  # checkout using the revision expected by this NuttX tree.
  if ! "${BUILD_SH}" "${CONFIG_PATH}" context; then
    echo "HAL bootstrap via build.sh context failed." >&2
    echo "Expected HAL checkout:" >&2
    echo "  ${HAL_DIR}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  if ! hal_checkout_ready; then
    echo "build.sh context completed, but the HAL checkout was not created." >&2
    echo "Expected:" >&2
    echo "  ${HAL_DIR}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "HAL checkout bootstrapped successfully."
  echo "HAL HEAD: $(git -C "${HAL_DIR}" rev-parse HEAD)"
}

function build_board()
{
  echo -e "Build command line:"
  echo -e "  ${TOOLSDIR}/configure.sh -e $1"
  echo -e "  make -C ${NUTTXDIR} EXTRAFLAGS="$EXTRA_FLAGS" ${@:2}"
  echo -e "  make -C ${NUTTXDIR} savedefconfig"

  KCONFIG_ARGS="--enable-mconf --disable-nconf --disable-gconf --disable-qconf"
  if [ `uname` == "Darwin" ]; then
    KCONFIG_ARGS+=" --disable-shared --enable-static"
  fi

  if [ ! -f "${ROOTDIR}/prebuilts/kconfig-frontends/bin/kconfig-conf" ] &&
     [ ! -x "$(command -v kconfig-conf)" ]; then
    pushd ${ROOTDIR}/prebuilts/kconfig-frontends
    ./configure --prefix=${ROOTDIR}/prebuilts/kconfig-frontends ${KCONFIG_ARGS} 1>/dev/null
    touch aclocal.m4 Makefile.in
    make install 1>/dev/null
    popd
  fi
  export PATH=${ROOTDIR}/prebuilts/kconfig-frontends/bin:$PATH

  if ! ${TOOLSDIR}/configure.sh -e $1; then
    echo "Error: ############# config ${1} fail ##############"
    exit 1
  fi

  if [[ ${CUSTOM_COMPILER} == "tasking" ]]; then
    kconfig-tweak --file ${NUTTXDIR}/.config --enable CONFIG_TRICORE_TOOLCHAIN_TASKING
  fi

  GHS_OPTS_STRING="CONFIG_ARCH_TOOLCHAIN_GHS=y"
  TASKING_OPTS_STRING="CONFIG_TRICORE_TOOLCHAIN_TASKING=y"
  if grep -qE "^(${GHS_OPTS_STRING}|${TASKING_OPTS_STRING})$" "${NUTTXDIR}/.config"; then
    echo "EXTRA_FLAGS are required to update the when using the GHS or Tasking toolchain."
    EXTRA_FLAGS=$(echo "$EXTRA_FLAGS" | sed 's/-Wno-cpp//' | xargs)
  fi

  if ! ${BEAR} make -C ${NUTTXDIR} EXTRAFLAGS="$EXTRA_FLAGS" ${@:2}; then
    echo "Error: ############# build ${1} fail ##############"
    exit 2
  else
    if [ -f "${COMPILE_COMMANDS}" ]; then
      cp ${COMPILE_COMMANDS} ${COMPILE_COMMANDS_BACKUP}
    fi
  fi

  if echo "${@:2}" | grep -q "distclean"; then
    if [ -f "${COMPILE_COMMANDS}" ]; then
      rm -rf ${COMPILE_COMMANDS}
    fi
    return;
  fi

  if ! make -C ${NUTTXDIR} savedefconfig; then
    echo "Error: ############# save ${1} fail ##############"
    exit 3
  fi

  if [ ! -d $1 ]; then
    cp ${NUTTXDIR}/defconfig ${ROOTDIR}/nuttx/boards/*/*/${1/[:|\/]//configs/}
  else
    if grep -q "#include" "$1/defconfig"; then
      echo "Note: skipping savedefconfig for debug defconfig."
    else
      cp ${NUTTXDIR}/defconfig $1
    fi
  fi
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Build the contest ESP32-S3 board with a temporary, reversible
# esp-hal-3rdparty lock-initializer backport.
#
# Fresh workspaces may not contain esp-hal-3rdparty yet. NuttX prepares it
# during the normal build context phase, so this wrapper bootstraps that
# phase first when needed, then applies the local backport and performs the
# real build.
# ROBOT_VOICE_TRANSPORT_HOOKS_V2: contest-local Agent source tree is authoritative.

set -euo pipefail

readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly OPENVELA_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../../.." && pwd)"
readonly CONFIG_PATH="vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_295_board/configs/nsh"
readonly HAL_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/esp_hal_lock_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_BREAK_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/nuttx_xtensa_break_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_RAW_EXC_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/nuttx_xtensa_raw_exception_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_RAW_EXC="${NUTTX_RAW_EXC:-0}"
readonly AI_AGENT_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/ai_agent_esp32s3_backport.sh"  # compatibility-only; never edits Agent source
readonly FFMPEG_AMIX_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/ffmpeg_amix_backport.sh"
readonly VOICE_HOOK_HEADER="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/robot_voice_agent_hooks.h"
readonly MYENV_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/myenv"
readonly BUILD_SH="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/build.sh"
readonly NUTTX_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/nuttx"
readonly HAL_DIR="${NUTTX_DIR}/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3/esp-hal-3rdparty"
readonly AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/packages/ai_agent"

readonly VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED="${VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED:-0}"
readonly VOICE_TLS_SRC="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/src/infra/vela_tls.c"
readonly VOICE_MIMO_SRC="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/src/voice/mimo_voice.c"
# These are user-owned source trees.  build.sh context is allowed to prepare
# its generated context and HAL checkout, but it must not replace local source
# files before the actual make.  Override this list when the project layout
# uses different source roots.
readonly LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS="${LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS:-packages/ai_agent contest2026_295_suanliheidong/packages/ai_agent contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src}"
readonly LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/openvela-local-source-${BASHPID}"

cd "${OPENVELA_ROOT}"

snapshot_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive
  local found=0

  mkdir -p "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}"
  : > "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"

  for rel in ${LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS}; do
    if test ! -d "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/${rel}"; then
      echo "Local source snapshot: skip missing ${rel}" >&2
      continue
    fi

    archive="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/${rel//\//__}.tar"
    # Snapshot user-owned source/config only.  Never preserve generated
    # objects/archives, otherwise restore_local_sources() can resurrect stale
    # code after a context/clean operation.
    tar -C "${OPENVELA_ROOT}" \
      --exclude=.git \
      --exclude='*.o' \
      --exclude='*.a' \
      --exclude='*.d' \
      --exclude='*.gcno' \
      --exclude='*.gcda' \
      -cpf "${archive}" "${rel}"
    printf '%s\n' "${rel}" >> "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"
    found=1
  done

  if test "${found}" != 1; then
    echo "No local source roots were found; refusing to build without source protection." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "Local source snapshot created; context may not replace local source files."
}

restore_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive
  local restore_root="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/restore"

  rm -rf "${restore_root}"
  mkdir -p "${restore_root}"

  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    archive="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/${rel//\//__}.tar"
    tar -C "${restore_root}" -xpf "${archive}"
    rsync -a --delete \
      --exclude='.git' \
      --exclude='*.o' \
      --exclude='*.a' \
      --exclude='*.d' \
      --exclude='*.gcno' \
      --exclude='*.gcda' \
      --exclude='*.pyc' \
      --exclude='__pycache__/' \
      "${restore_root}/${rel}/" "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/${rel}/"
  done < "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"

  rm -rf "${restore_root}"

  echo "Local source snapshot restored; compiling the files present before context."
}

apply_contest_ai_agent_overlay()
{
  if test ! -d "${AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR}"; then
    echo "Missing contest-local ai_agent overlay: ${AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR}" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  # The generated build context still resolves the package from
  # packages/ai_agent.  Synchronize the complete contest-local package there,
  # including deletions, while leaving the nested Git metadata and generated
  # build artifacts alone. restore_local_sources() restores the original
  # checkout at EXIT.
  ai_agent_overlay_applied=1
  rsync -a --delete \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.o' \
    --exclude='*.a' \
    --exclude='*.d' \
    --exclude='*.gcno' \
    --exclude='*.gcda' \
    --exclude='*.pyc' \
    --exclude='__pycache__/' \
    "${AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR}/" "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/"

  echo "Complete contest-local ai_agent source tree applied; build uses the contest copy."
}

cleanup_local_source_snapshot()
{
  if test -d "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}"; then
    rm -rf "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}"
  fi
}

if test ! -x "${MYENV_DIR}/bin/python"; then
  echo "Creating Python virtual environment: ${MYENV_DIR}"
  python3 -m venv "${MYENV_DIR}"
fi

# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "${MYENV_DIR}/bin/activate"

# Keep the board-local esptool wrapper ahead of the system PATH.
export PATH="${SCRIPT_DIR}:${PATH}"

hal_checkout_ready()
{
  git -C "${HAL_DIR}" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1
}

reset_generated_build_state()
{
  rm -f "${NUTTX_DIR}/.config" \
        "${NUTTX_DIR}/Make.defs" \
        "${NUTTX_DIR}/staging/libarch.a" \
        "${NUTTX_DIR}/staging/libboard.a"
}

bootstrap_hal_checkout()
{
  if hal_checkout_ready; then
    return 0
  fi

  echo "HAL checkout is missing:"
  echo "  ${HAL_DIR}"
  echo
  echo "Bootstrapping the normal NuttX build context first..."

  reset_generated_build_state

  # Follow openvela's normal build path so NuttX creates/clones the ESP HAL
  # checkout using the revision expected by this NuttX tree.
  if ! "${BUILD_SH}" "${CONFIG_PATH}" context; then
    echo "HAL bootstrap via build.sh context failed." >&2
    echo "Expected HAL checkout:" >&2
    echo "  ${HAL_DIR}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  if ! hal_checkout_ready; then
    echo "build.sh context completed, but the HAL checkout was not created." >&2
    echo "Expected:" >&2
    echo "  ${HAL_DIR}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "HAL checkout bootstrapped successfully."
  echo "HAL HEAD: $(git -C "${HAL_DIR}" rev-parse HEAD)"
}

refresh_demo_kconfig()
{
  local app link target
  mkdir -p "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/demos"
  for app in robot_agentctl robot_voice robotctl; do
    link="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/demos/contest2026_295_${app}"
    target="../../contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/${app}"
    if test ! -e "${link}" && test ! -L "${link}"; then
      ln -s "${target}" "${link}"
    elif test ! -d "${link}" ||
         test "$(cd "${link}" && pwd -P)" != "$(cd "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/${app}" && pwd -P)"; then
      echo "Unexpected demo path: ${link}; refusing to replace it." >&2
      return 1
    fi
  done
  (
    cd "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/demos"
    "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/apps/tools/mkkconfig.sh" -m Demos -o Kconfig
  )

readonly LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS="${LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS:-packages/ai_agent contest2026_295_suanliheidong/packages/ai_agent contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src}"
readonly LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/openvela-local-source-${BASHPID}"

cd "${OPENVELA_ROOT}"

snapshot_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive
  local found=0

  mkdir -p "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}"
  : > "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"

  for rel in ${LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS}; do
    if test ! -d "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/${rel}"; then
      echo "Local source snapshot: skip missing ${rel}" >&2
      continue
    fi

    archive="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/${rel//\//__}.tar"
    # Snapshot user-owned source/config only.  Never preserve generated
    # objects/archives, otherwise restore_local_sources() can resurrect stale
    # code after a context/clean operation.
    tar -C "${OPENVELA_ROOT}" \
      --exclude=.git \
      --exclude='*.o' \
      --exclude='*.a' \
      --exclude='*.d' \
      --exclude='*.gcno' \
      --exclude='*.gcda' \
      -cpf "${archive}" "${rel}"
    printf '%s\n' "${rel}" >> "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"
    found=1
  done

  if test "${found}" != 1; then
    echo "No local source roots were found; refusing to build without source protection." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "Local source snapshot created; context may not replace local source files."
}

restore_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive
  local restore_root="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/restore"

  rm -rf "${restore_root}"
  mkdir -p "${restore_root}"

  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    archive="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/${rel//\//__}.tar"
    tar -C "${restore_root}" -xpf "${archive}"
    rsync -a --delete \
      --exclude='.git' \
      --exclude='*.o' \
      --exclude='*.a' \
      --exclude='*.d' \
      --exclude='*.gcno' \
      --exclude='*.gcda' \
      --exclude='*.pyc' \
      --exclude='__pycache__/' \
      "${restore_root}/${rel}/" "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/${rel}/"
  done < "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"

  rm -rf "${restore_root}"

  echo "Local source snapshot restored; compiling the files present before context."
}

apply_contest_ai_agent_overlay()
{
  if test ! -d "${AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR}"; then
    echo "Missing contest-local ai_agent overlay: ${AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR}" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  # The generated build context still resolves the package from
  # packages/ai_agent.  Synchronize the complete contest-local package there,
  # including deletions, while leaving the nested Git metadata and generated
  # build artifacts alone. restore_local_sources() restores the original
  # checkout at EXIT.
  ai_agent_overlay_applied=1
  rsync -a --delete \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.o' \
    --exclude='*.a' \
    --exclude='*.d' \
    --exclude='*.gcno' \
    --exclude='*.gcda' \
    --exclude='*.pyc' \
    --exclude='__pycache__/' \
    "${AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR}/" "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/"

  echo "Complete contest-local ai_agent source tree applied; build uses the contest copy."
}

save_hal_to_cache()
{

    echo "Cannot cache HAL: checkout is not a Git work tree." >&2

    return 1

  cache_parent="$(dirname "${HAL_CACHE_DIR}")"
  cache_tmp="${HAL_CACHE_DIR}.tmp-${BASHPID}"
  mkdir -p "${cache_parent}"
  rm -rf "${cache_tmp}"
  rsync -a --delete "${HAL_DIR}/" "${cache_tmp}/"

  if test "$(git -C "${cache_tmp}" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)" != "${HAL_EXPECTED_VERSION}"; then

    rm -rf "${HAL_CACHE_DIR}"
  fi
  mv "${cache_tmp}" "${HAL_CACHE_DIR}"
  echo "HAL backup saved locally: ${HAL_CACHE_DIR}"
}

#############################################################################
# Espressif HAL for 3rd Party Platforms
#############################################################################

# Fetch source files and add them to build

ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO = esp-hal-3rdparty
ifndef ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION
	ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION = 9fc713a95b1ff150dd0b0647e465d3c624056bb1
endif

ifndef ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_URL
	ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_URL = https://github.com/espressif/esp-hal-3rdparty.git
endif

ifndef DISABLE_GIT_DEPTH
ifndef GIT_DEPTH
	GIT_DEPTH=1
endif
	GIT_DEPTH_PARAMETER = --depth=$(GIT_DEPTH)
endif

# When set USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY=y, will directly use esp-hal-3rdparty
# under nxtmpdir without CHECK_COMMITSHA, reset, checkout and update.

USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY ?= n

ifeq ($(STORAGETMP),y)
ifeq ($(USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY),y)
define CLONE_ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO
	$(call COPYDIR, $(NXTMPDIR)/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO),chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO))
endef
else
define CLONE_ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO
	$(call CHECK_COMMITSHA, $(NXTMPDIR)/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO),$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION))
	$(call CLONE, $(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_URL),chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO),$(NXTMPDIR)/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO))
endef
endif
else
define CLONE_ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO
	$(call CLONE, $(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_URL),chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO))
endef
endif

chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO):
	$(Q) echo "Cloning Espressif HAL for 3rd Party Platforms"
	$(Q) $(call CLONE_ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO)
ifneq ($(USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY),y)
	$(Q) echo "Espressif HAL for 3rd Party Platforms: ${ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION}"
	$(Q) git -C chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO) checkout --quiet $(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION)
endif

# Silent preprocessor warnings

CFLAGS += -Wno-undef -Wno-unused-variable -fno-jump-tables -fno-tree-switch-conversion
CFLAGS += ${DEFINE_PREFIX}_RETARGETABLE_LOCKING

# Enable strict volatile bitfield access

CFLAGS += -fstrict-volatile-bitfields

AFLAGS += $(CFLAGS)

# Files that require the HAL recipe

include chip/Bootloader.mk

CHIP_SERIES = $(patsubst "%",%,$(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_CHIP_SERIES))

include chip/hal.mk

include common/espressif/Make.defs

context:: chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO)
ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESP32S3_WIRELESS),y)
ifneq ($(USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY),y)
	$(Q) echo "Espressif HAL for 3rd Party Platforms: initializing submodules..."
	$(Q) git -C chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO) submodule --quiet update --init $(GIT_DEPTH_PARAMETER) components/mbedtls/mbedtls components/esp_phy/lib components/esp_wifi/lib components/bt/controller/lib_esp32c3_family components/esp_coex/lib
	$(Q) git -C chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO)/components/mbedtls/mbedtls reset --quiet --hard
endif
	$(Q) echo "Applying patches..."
	$(Q) cd chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO)/components/mbedtls/mbedtls && git apply ../../../nuttx/patches/components/mbedtls/mbedtls/*.patch
endif

ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESP32S3_WIRELESS),y)
include chip/Wireless.mk
endif

distclean::
	$(call DELDIR,chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO))

refresh_restored_build_context()
{
  # build.sh context may prepare/copy board/application context before the
  # contest-local source snapshot is restored.  Existing source files still
  # compile after restore, but a newly-added source file can be missing from
  # the generated application source list.  Re-run the NuttX context target
  # after restore so the active contest CMakeLists.txt/Kconfig are evaluated
  # again without invoking build.sh's copy/configure phase a second time.

  run_configured_make context

run_configured_make()

define DOWNLOAD
	$(ECHO_BEGIN)"Downloading: $(if $3,$3,$2) "
	$(Q) curl -L $(if $(V),,-Ss) $(1)/$(2) -o $(if $(3),$(3),$(2))
	$(ECHO_END)
endef

# CLONE - Git clone repository. Initializes a new Git repository in the
#         folder on your local machine and populates it with the contents
#         of the central repository.
#         The third argument is an storage path. The second argument is used
#         if it is not provided or is empty.
# Example: $(call CLONE,$(URL_BASE),$(PATH),$(STORAGE_FOLDER))

define CLONE
	$(ECHO_BEGIN)"Clone: $(if $3,$3,$2) "
	if [ -z $3 ]; then \
		git clone --quiet $1 $2; \
	else \
		if [ ! -d $3 ]; then \
			git clone --quiet $1 $3; \
		fi; \
		cp -fr $3 $2; \
	fi
	$(ECHO_END)
endef

# CHECK_COMMITSHA - Check if the branch contains the commit SHA-1.
#         Remove the folder if the commit is not present in the branch.
#         The first argument is the repository folder on the local machine.
#         The second argument is a unique SHA-1 hash value.
# Example: $(call CHECK_COMMITSHA,$(GIT_FOLDER),$(COMMIT_SHA-1))
ifndef DISABLE_GIT_DEPTH
ifndef GIT_DEPTH
	GIT_DEPTH=1
endif
	GIT_DEPTH_PARAMETER = --depth=$(GIT_DEPTH)
endif

# When set USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY=y, will directly use esp-hal-3rdparty
# under nxtmpdir without CHECK_COMMITSHA, reset, checkout and update.

USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY ?= n

ifeq ($(STORAGETMP),y)
ifeq ($(USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY),y)
define CLONE_ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO
	$(call COPYDIR, $(NXTMPDIR)/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO),chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO))
endef
else
define CLONE_ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO
	$(call CHECK_COMMITSHA, $(NXTMPDIR)/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO),$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION))
	$(call CLONE, $(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_URL),chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO),$(NXTMPDIR)/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO))
endef
endif
else
define CLONE_ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO
	$(call CLONE, $(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_URL),chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO))
endef
endif

chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO):
	$(Q) echo "Cloning Espressif HAL for 3rd Party Platforms"
	$(Q) $(call CLONE_ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO)
ifneq ($(USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY),y)
	$(Q) echo "Espressif HAL for 3rd Party Platforms: ${ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION}"
	$(Q) git -C chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO) checkout --quiet $(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION)
endif

# Silent preprocessor warnings

CFLAGS += -Wno-undef -Wno-unused-variable -fno-jump-tables -fno-tree-switch-conversion
CFLAGS += ${DEFINE_PREFIX}_RETARGETABLE_LOCKING
